newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Podravka takes spotlight.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Podravka takes spotlight.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed on Thursday in dwindling trade, with food processor Podravka coming into the spotlight.
* Five of 13 issues rose, six fell and two ended flat.
* Volume was more than halved at 4,562 units with turnover totalling 2.4 million kuna.
* Podravka, selling 2,027 shares, was the most actively traded issue and rose five kuna or 2.04 percent to 250.
* Zagrebacka Banka's 2C series bearer stock led gainers, adding 30 kuna or 3.52 percent to 880 kuna on volume of 65 shares.
* Zagrebacka's ordinaries headed down five kuna to 2,015 on volume of 504.
* Another blue chip Pliva pharmaceuticals lost one kuna to 484 with 100 units sold.
* Biggest decliner shipper Jadroplov lost 12 kuna or 7.5 percent to 148 on volume of 226 shares.
